references.phrase: finite zigzag of arrows between objects
references.context: A finite sequence of consecutive objects with a morphism joining each pair in either direction; arrows need not be invertible

references.disposition: The nonemptiness requirement is explicit; an empty category is not connected under this convention.

references.phrase: directions of zigzag arrows may alternate
references.disposition: Connectivity uses the underlying undirected incidence of morphisms, not a directed path condition.

review_rationale: Read nonemptiness and undirected zigzag connectivity of any two objects through finitely many morphisms in a category. Did not require a single forward arrow, invertibility of arrows, or topological connectedness.
